text:
**Review Result**

Score: **5.5/10**.

The core package is readable and fairly well-structured, but I would not approve it as-is. The biggest problem is reproducibility: the repo has checked-in tiny outputs, an empty default story dataset, and a `generate-stories` command that appears unable to bootstrap a fresh dataset. That makes the documented `make demo` / `emovec all --tiny` path unreliable.

Verification was limited: `pytest -q` failed during collection because this interpreter lacks `numpy`; `emovec` itself imports, but tests could not run. I also checked current Hugging Face docs and did not count `dtype=` in `from_pretrained` as a compatibility issue because current docs document that parameter. ([huggingface.co](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers/en/main_classes/model))

Estimated rewrite/significant-change size: **~300 LOC**.

Bottom line: **No, I would not approve this PR as-is.**

issues.description: Default stories_dir points at an empty data/stories directory, so extract/all cannot reproduce the checked-in outputs.
generate-stories requires an existing manifest before it can generate stories, blocking a fresh dataset bootstrap.
load_vectors does not validate manifest model/scale/emotion compatibility, allowing stale or mismatched vectors to be silently reused.
pca_components divides by total variance without guarding zero/degenerate input, producing NaNs.
mean_activations can divide by zero for one-token or empty-tokenized texts.
all_token_activations blindly drops token 0 as BOS even for tokenizers that do not insert a BOS token.
Steering hooks rely on mutable model-wide _steer_mask state, making concurrent calls on one EmoModel unsafe.
Story generation HTTP calls have no timeout or retry/error handling, so the command can hang indefinitely.
Runtime dependencies are only lower-bounded, making ML results and API behavior hard to reproduce over time.
Integration test unconditionally loads a gated external model without skip logic for missing HF auth or offline environments.
Generated egg-info and outputs artifacts are present in the workspace despite ignore rules, adding cleanup/review noise.
